confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Taiwanese prices, not live listings. Restaurant and café anchors are moderately reliable; the hotel and hostel anchors are less certain and assume typical July rates. The FX value was taken from search summaries attributed to the RBA, not from a full read of the RBA page, so it should be checked against the official table.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on general knowledge of mid-sized Taiwanese cities such as Tainan and Kaohsiung, adjusted for Taichung's somewhat lower restaurant and accommodation prices than Taipei. No specific comparable venues were checked.
